title: Grill — Harness account stacks (backup accounts, automatic failover)

stack-model.title: What is a "stack" in the model: a fallback chain attached to each account, or a separate named group?
stack-model.display: A chain attached to each account

same-kind.title: Must every member be the same harness kind, or can a stack fall through to a different kind (Claude → Codex)?

v1-kinds.title: Which harness kinds must a stack support in v1?
v1-kinds.other: Claude Code and Codex for now
v1-kinds.display: Other: Claude Code and Codex for now

claude-limit-notice.title: Claude Code handles a usage limit by waiting for the reset itself. Should Agetor preempt that and swap to the backup?
claude-limit-notice.display: Detect the notice and swap immediately

limit-signals.title: Which failures count as "this account reached its limit" and should trigger a swap?
limit-signals.display: Provider quota exhausted; HTTP 429 / rate limited; 402 / insufficient credits

mid-turn.title: When the limit hits mid-turn, what should happen to the turn?
mid-turn.display: Resume the same turn on the backup

history-fidelity.title: What does "preserve the conversation" mean for the backup?

capability-sharing.title: How should the backup get the primary's user-level MCP servers, skills, commands and CLI settings?
capability-sharing.display: Mirror everything, including settings and hooks

credentials.title: Should Agetor ever copy or share authentication tokens between accounts?

all-exhausted.title: When every member is exhausted, what should the task do?
all-exhausted.display: Block with a countdown, then retry automatically

naming.title: Name in the UI and docs
naming.value: **Harness stack**, with **accounts** as members and **stack** as the verb

running-ux.title: What the task shows during the swap
running-ux.value: The task stays `running`; the old run's failure toast is suppressed; a status line says `Switching to backup…` before the new run starts, then the swap notice

persist-intent.title: Crash/restart safety
persist-intent.value: Persist the swap intent (like `fxRecovery`) and reconcile it on boot, so a core restart mid-swap resumes or fails cleanly

acceptance.title: What "done" means for v1
acceptance.value: An e2e two-account Claude stack survives a simulated limit, shows the swap notice, and preserves the conversation; per-kind adapter tests for Codex and OpenCode; a unit test for the limit classifier; and no credential file is ever copied
acceptance.note: not necessarily using real claude account for the tests
